page.overview:
Who is Corrin VIII?

Padishah Emperor Corrin VIII was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 2727–2756 AG), succeeding his father Sidir XIV Estil III.

Corrin was succeeded in 2756 by his son Elrood V.
